items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Neal was very fast and he wrote everything in concert

ctx.x: Ernie Wilkins said I guess that Neal wrote for the band more than anybody else.

Yeah, he did, well Neal was very fast and he wrote everything in concert and he seemed to know every shortcut there was. He could write simply, he could write five arrangements in the time it could take me to do one.
Apparently Neal and Billy Byers get the speed demon awards, among arrangers.
